title: Overpayment Refunds on Water Damage Mitigation Jobs
content:
Water Damage Mitigation credit balances are refunded back to the customer's own tender under this policy.

## Policy
The job must be in invoiced or cancelled status when a refund is issued. A refund may be issued only while the job's balance due is negative. The refund equals the credit balance, but never more than the amount of the customer payment it is returned from, and goes back to that payment's original tender; when the credit balance exceeds the latest customer payment, the remainder is refunded from the next most recent customer payment. A credit balance created by insurance proceeds is not refunded to the customer by the desk and is handed to a human representative as not covered by policy, because carrier overpayments are returned to the carrier. The refund is issued within the refund processing period in business days.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)
A cancelled job shows a credit balance of $260.00. Its latest customer payment was $200.00 by ACH and the one before it $150.00 by debit card. The refund is $200.00 back to the ACH account from the latest payment, and the remaining $60.00 back to the debit card from the next most recent payment.

## Points of judgement
| Situation | Refund by the desk? |
|---|---|
| Balance due negative, job invoiced or cancelled, credit created by customer payments | yes, to the original tender, capped at each source payment |
| Balance due zero or positive | no |
| Credit balance created by insurance proceeds | no; handed to a human representative as not covered by policy |
